components.name: .Breadcrumb/Item
components.description: One breadcrumb step. Type = Link | Current | Overflow; State = Default | Hover | Focus (Current has Default only); Size = S (Body/S) | M (Body/M) = 14 variants. Show icon puts a home icon before the label (first step only). Separators live in Breadcrumb, not here. Hover darkens the label (foreground/neutral/default); underline is added in code.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Breadcrumb trail. Size = S | M × Layout = Full (web) | Collapsed (tablet, "…" opens a Dropdown menu) | Back (mobile, one link to the parent) = 6 variants. Steps are exposed .Breadcrumb/Item instances (toggle the home icon on the Home item); Show step 3/4 shortens the trail; separators are arrow-right-01 on foreground/neutral/subtle.
